meanings: to be in, to be at
to belong to; to be part of
boubou (type of robe worn by men in Senegal)
a slave; someone belonging to the lowest tier of society
to meet (each other), come together, gather
to teach (sb sth) at a specific place, in a specific manner, or with a specific instrument
the ninth month of the Islamic lunar calendar, Ramadan
to give (sb) sth at a specific place, in a specific manner, or with a specific instrument
to be full, to not be hungry
to wash a piece of linen for the first time
shuttle (sliding thread holder in a sewing machine)
Marks a focused complement or “is”; also object “you” (singular).
